name: legend-pure-lsp
description: Language support for Legend Pure (.pure files)

legendPure.server.jarPath.description: Absolute path to the Legend Pure LSP server JAR. If empty, the extension looks for the JAR in the default Maven build output directory relative to the workspace.

legendPure.server.extraClasspath.description: Extra local JAR files, directories, or directory wildcards to append to the LSP server Java classpath. Directory entries add both the directory and its JAR wildcard. Changing this setting requires reloading the VS Code window.

legendPure.server.classpathFile.description: Path to a file containing additional Java classpath entries, separated by the platform path separator. This is useful with Maven dependency:build-classpath for large host repositories. Changing this setting requires reloading the VS Code window.

legendPure.java.home.description: Path to a Java 11+ installation. If empty, 'java' from PATH is used.

legendPure.server.autoStart.description: Start (or connect to) the LSP server automatically when a .pure file is opened. Off by default: on a large workspace, starting means launching a multi-GB JVM. Use the status bar item or 'Legend Pure: Start / Connect LSP Server' instead. Workspaces configured to attach to an already-running daemon can safely turn this on.

legendPure.server.connectOnly.description: Only ever connect to an existing LSP daemon on 'legendPure.server.connectPort'; never resolve a classpath and never launch a process. Use this when the daemon's lifecycle is owned by something else, so the extension can neither start nor stop it. Takes precedence over every other connection setting.

legendPure.server.connectPort.description: Loopback TCP port of the LSP daemon to attach to when 'legendPure.server.connectOnly' is set. Only 127.0.0.1 is supported; a remote server needs an SSH tunnel exposed as a local port first.

legendPure.server.launchPort.description: Run the LSP server in socket mode on this port, launching it only if nothing is already listening there. Unlike connectPort, this extension still owns the process it starts. 0 keeps the default stdio child process.

legendPure.server.configPath.description: Path to an optional JSON sidecar describing how to reach the LSP daemon (port / repoRoots / pureOptions / connectOnly / autoSyncWorkspace). Keeping this in a file rather than editor settings lets several clients share one description of the same daemon. Settings above take precedence over the sidecar.

legendPure.server.repoRoots.description: Repository roots the LSP session should span, overriding this window's workspace folders. Only takes effect when this extension is the first client to reach the daemon: the server fixes its roots once and ignores later clients' roots.

legendPure.server.pureOptions.description: System properties passed as -D<key>=<value> when this extension launches the server. Pure runtime options use the 'pure.options.' prefix, e.g. {"pure.options.ForceInterpreted": "true"}. Ignored when attaching to a daemon started elsewhere.

legendPure.server.jvmArgs.description: Extra JVM arguments for a server this extension launches, e.g. ["-Xmx8g", "-Dlegend.lsp.requestPoolSize=12"]. Ignored when attaching to a daemon started elsewhere.

legendPure.server.autoSyncWorkspace.description: Automatically apply .pure changes made outside the editor (git checkout, rebase, external tools) that the server reports as workspace drift. When off, drift raises a Sync All / Review / Dismiss prompt instead.

function.description: Zero-argument Pure function signature to debug.

languageModelTools.name: legend-pure-search-symbols
languageModelTools.userDescription: Search for Pure classes, functions, enums by name
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search for Pure language elements (classes, functions, enums, associations, profiles) by name in the configured workspace. Returns qualified paths, element kind, and file locations. Use this to find where something is defined in Pure code.

query.description: Search query — matches element names case-insensitively. Examples: 'Person', 'relational', 'graphFetch'

languageModelTools.name: legend-pure-execute-go
languageModelTools.userDescription: Compile and run the Pure go() function
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Compile and execute the go():Any[*] function in the current Pure workspace. Returns the console output or compilation/execution errors. Use this to run Pure code.

languageModelTools.name: legend-pure-get-source
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read a Pure source file by its source ID
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read the content of a Pure source file by its source ID (e.g., '/core/pure/lang.pure') or pure:// URI. Returns the full source text. Use this to read Pure code that you found via symbol search.

sourceId.description: Pure source ID (e.g., '/core/pure/lang.pure') or pure:// URI
